svg.title: FAST-LIO pipeline (schematic)
svg.desc: LiDAR points are preprocessed and deskewed using IMU propagation; an iterated Kalman update computes point-to-plane residuals against the ikd-Tree map; the converged pose is output and the scan is inserted into the map.
